Measure and apply the no-LLM bootable-app gate

positional arguments:
  {validate,regate}
    validate         Measure the gate's precision floor and recall against the
                     backlog
    regate           Re-gate the backlog pending stages 3 and 4

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --db DB            Registry database (default: pipeline_data/registry.db)
